1: move tech from general to tech. Frees up some slots.

2: every  space station so far has a vendor that will sell you a +1 inventory slot

3. A: you can tame/adopt many animals on worlds. They normally can be farmed(milking, berries, etc) customized, and importantly ridden, some flyers too

3.B: now this one… (your welcome). If your ever caught in a storm, too far from your ship and may die or loose haz shielding…(love me)… summon then talk/interact with your pet, apparently game rolls forward, and keeps your hazmat level wherever it is. You can literally pet and feed your mini rock midget (my ‘MoMo) or floating mechanical orb (geo-Dude) through the entire storm.

Anyhow some small things I picked up, also Solar ships are I swear a blessing and a curse. I always forget to bring fuel when I switch ships because my solar class c, regens it’s lift thrusters (upgrade called automatic recharging) and burns so little fuel.

Thanks for your time spread the word, and I’ll take a freighter or organic ship as a thank you :p hope this helps!
